title: Joplin: free Evernote alternative
caption:
Evernote charges $99/year to sync your notes across devices. Joplin does it for free 📓

✅ Markdown notes, organised into notebooks, with to-do lists
✅ Web clipper to save pages from your browser
✅ Sync with Dropbox, OneDrive, Nextcloud or WebDAV
✅ End-to-end encryption, no ads

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux · iPhone · Android
ℹ️ The app and syncing through your own Dropbox, OneDrive or Nextcloud are free. Joplin's own sync service, Joplin Cloud, is an optional paid extra.
